title: Hunga Tonga 2022 pressure wave: every passage over seven days at the 102 US ASOS barometers of seis-tonga (IEM one-minute pressure)
verdict_rule: Laps that change with the station's position, as any echo would make them, or no regular passages after the first two.
license_note: Iowa Environmental Mesonet (Iowa State University) archive of NWS/FAA ASOS one-minute data: open, no account; credit IEM.

sources.cite: Iowa Environmental Mesonet, ASOS one-minute data (pres1), 2022-01-15 to 2022-01-22

R. S. Matoza et al., Atmospheric waves and global seismoacoustic observations of the January 2022 Hunga eruption, Tonga, Science 377 (2022) 95-100 (four outbound and three antipodal passages over six days)

units.pres1: inHg in the raw files (x 33.8639 = hPa)
units.theta: degrees, great-circle angle from the vent (computed after picking; drawing only)

inputs.origin: Iowa Environmental Mesonet, ASOS one-minute pressure (pres1), one request per station for 2022-01-15 to 2022-01-22 (fog fetch atmo-tonga-laps).
inputs.caveats: Station barometers report to 0.01 inHg-class precision and some minutes are missing; gaps are skipped, not filled.

notes: Same stations as seis-tonga (its raw station lists choose them). Picks use no Earth model: each passage is the largest band-passed peak 6 to 30 h after the previous one. A lap is read at one station, so neither the position nor the explosion time enters.
